title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ — Tuesday, September 15, 2026

🌤️ Weather
Cool and clear. High 71°F / Low 59°F, currently low 70s with light north winds and just scattered clouds. Grab a light jacket for the evening — you won't need much more.

🗞️ Headlines
• Pennsylvania's measles outbreak nears 700 cases (2 deaths, 130+ hospitalized) across 38 counties.
• AI showdown in Washington: Anthropic's Dario Amodei calls for an AI slowdown; Trump pushes back, dismissing rogue-AI fears.
• Russian drone strikes a train near the Ukraine–Poland border shortly after visiting officials passed; Poland pledges tighter border security.
• Indonesia intensifies search after a ferry capsized in bad weather in the Java Sea.
• NYC: Mayor Mamdani + AG Letitia James made a major immigration announcement this week.

🚇 Getting around
Notable service hits today: no B trains in the Bronx/Upper Manhattan, C express suspended 125 St–Columbus Circle, and D running with delays. J/M delayed after a brake incident on the Williamsburg Bridge. Check MTA before you head out.

🎉 NYC today
It's NYFW — Mary Kay takes over Gansevoort Plaza and Theory debuts its Fall campaign in the Meatpacking District. Tonight: Charli xcx at Barclays Center (7:30) and TLC & Salt-N-Pepa with En Vogue at Jones Beach (7:30).

💡 Nugget
Today is National Voter Registration Day — HeadCount's Block Party runs 10 AM–6 PM. Two minutes to check your registration at vote.org is a solid start to the day.
